features: Wireless Conference Screen Mirroring System:The Lemorele conference screen mirroring system is designed for efficient meetings. With wireless USB-C transmitter and HDMI receiver, it lets you wirelessly stream content from laptops/devices to conference all-in-ones, projectors, or TVs—no complicated setup needed. Its standalone networking technology supports high-definition mirroring1080P@60fps even without Wi-Fi, completely eliminating cable clutter and keeping your meeting room neat

Type-C Port PD 45W Fast Charging:Perfectly compatible with Type-C iPhone and various devices, it supports wireless mirroring—driven by the wireless video transmitter and receiver—for all streaming platforms like Netflix, Prime Video, and Hulu. Real-time screen sync works no internet connection required. plus a PD 45W fast-charging port on the TX side, it lets you charge your device quickly while mirroring—so your meetings run all day without power issues.Note:Some low-power devices may automatically switch to slow charging mode

Plug and Play & Portable Design:The Lemorele wireless USB-C transmitter and HDMI receiver(Receiver requires a power connection) kit is plug-and-play, requiring no software installation, network connection, or cables. This keeps your desktop tidy. Its compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for both office use and travel.Note:Please make sure the USB-C port on your laptop supports video transmission. If it does not support this function, it will not work properly

Ultra-low latency:It has just an ultra-low latency of 30 milliseconds—so low that it's almost undetectable by the naked eye! Such ultra-low latency ensures smooth, instant performance, with almost no lag felt at all. Whether you're gaming, live streaming, or working, it delivers a lag-free experience, always staying incredibly fast and smoothly responsive.Note:While going through walls or obstacles may cause increased latency

50m Long-Range Transmission:Equipped with high-performance 2.4G/5G Wi-Fi modules, it enables stable hdmi wireless line-of-sight transmission up to 50m between the transmitter and receiver. With strong signal penetration, it covers complex scenarios like university lecture halls and large corporate meeting rooms. Note:While going through walls or encountering obstacles will reduce the distance and decrease the speed

Device Connection Steps:1 Connect the HDMI receiver to a power supply2 Connect the receiver to the display device via HDMI3 Insert the USB-C transmitter into the terminal device (laptop / mobile phone)4 Wait for pairing to complete, then start mirroring
